entry.title: Securitize Set to Go Public Thursday
entry.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Dushyant Shahrawat joins Isabelle Lee on "Bloomberg Crypto." entry.title: We Need To Save Venture Capital From Bad Data
entry.summary: Venture capital firms are using AI the wrong way, argues Gilion's Henrik Landgren, who says that building better data infrastructure and connecting directly to sources like financial, payment and accounting systems would improve due diligence, help investors identify overlooked startups, and make investment decisions both faster and more accurate.

entry.title: China, India See Top Firms Lose Market Cap Share in AI Lag
entry.summary: China, India, and Hong Kong have emerged as the only major stock markets worldwide where top companies account for a smaller share of market capitalization than a year ago, underscoring their lag in the global AI race.
